title: Regional debenture borrowing by-laws approved
subtitle: Special meeting approved debentures for Cambridge, Kitchener, Waterloo and the Region, plus a combined issue.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting to approve the by-laws needed for a debenture issue dated October 9, 2025. Council received a staff report on the issue for information and then approved all five by-laws together {{vote:m1}}.

Four by-laws authorize borrowing for capital works: one each for the cities of Cambridge, Kitchener and Waterloo, and one for the Region itself. A fifth by-law combines them into a single series of debentures totalling $97,000,000, with five, ten and twenty year terms.

This matters to residents because the Region borrows on behalf of the local cities as well as itself, and the debt pays for capital projects such as local infrastructure. Staff described the report as procedural, and no questions were raised before the vote. Council then adjourned {{vote:m7}}.

decisions.detail: Council authorized borrowing of $7,990,000 through ten year instalment and twenty year term debentures for a City of Cambridge capital work.
Council authorized borrowing of $49,709,000 through five, ten and twenty year debentures for City of Kitchener capital works.
Council authorized borrowing of $8,750,000 through ten year instalment debentures for a City of Waterloo capital work.
Council authorized borrowing of $30,551,000 through ten year instalment and twenty year term debentures for Regional capital works.
Council approved issuing one series of debentures totalling $97,000,000 to cover the amounts authorized in by-laws 25-048 to 25-051.

debate: There was no substantive debate. The Chair described the staff report on the debenture issue as procedural in nature, and finance staff were available for questions.
No councillor asked questions on the report before the by-laws were put to a vote.
The five by-laws were voted on together. One councillor who had trouble voting electronically gave a verbal vote in favour.
